## Description

Reader leaves ~900 MB resident on glibc after a 142 MB STEP file even after destructor runs; Windows VS allocator releases cleanly. Indicates fragmentation / arena retention rather than a true leak, but functionally OOMs in containers.

## Reproducer recipe

read 142 MB STEP, destroy reader, observe RSS.

## Expected kernel behavior

allocator-tuned working-set release;
